tg_house_b_wife: Three of us mended nets. Now two of us carry crates on the east mole.
It pays better. I want that on the record before anybody feels sorry for me.
I still do not know what is in them, and I have stopped putting my hand up to ask.
tg_house_b_kid: Dad says the sea is holding its breath.
So I asked what happens when it lets go. He did not answer.
So I asked louder. He still did not answer.
